 H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kit recalled for undeclared soy, almonds
 The product has a “best if used by” date of Oct. 30
 Andrea K. Moreno , Digital Journalist
 Published:  October 29, 2026 at 9:21 AM Tags:  H-E-B , Recall , Food , Consumer H-E-B Chopped Salad Kit (Courtesy of H-E-B) SAN ANTONIO – An H-E-B salad kit has been recalled due to potentially containing undeclared soy and almonds, the company announced Tuesday .
 The recalled product is the H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad Kit, 13.4 oz., with a “best if used by” date of Oct. 30, 2026. H-E-B stores across Texas sold the kit.
 Recommended Videos
 People with a soy or almond allergy should not eat the product, as they may be at risk of a serious allergic reaction. No adverse reactions have been reported.
 Customers who bought the product should throw it away or return it to H-E-B for a full refund.
